body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within natural weapon range. On a success, deal 1 Bludgeoning damage. You count as one size larger for this Action.

surges.html: Until your next turn, reduce damage from Burning or Bleeding by 1, minimum 0.
Choose one additional adjacent target for this Action.

rider.title: TITAN ADAPTATION
rider.html: Before resolving this Action, you may assume Ogre Frame. While maintained: You count as one size larger for Shoves, Grapples, and resisting forced movement.
